question: How many open claims does each West & South adjuster have?

report.interpretation: Open claims (status = 'open' on the extract date, 2026-09-30) for each adjuster whose region is West & South. The count covers motor and home claims. It includes the two adjusters who have left, because they are still on the adjusters table.
report.answer: The four current West & South adjusters carry 132 open claims between them. Daniel Jackson (ADJ-029) has 42, Judy Sanford (ADJ-030) has 33, Charles Robinson (ADJ-028) has 31 and Joshua Miller (ADJ-027) has 26. Jamie Jones (ADJ-025) and Abigail Foster (ADJ-026) left in May 2026 and have no open claims.
report.answer_sql: select a.adjuster_id, a.full_name, count(c.claim_id) filter (where c.status='open') as open_claims from adjusters a left join claims c on c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id where a.region='West & South' group by all order by open_claims desc, a.adjuster_id

findings.claim: Open claims per West & South adjuster. ADJ-029 has the most, at 42. The two adjusters who left have none.
